request.doc: The 21 bytes the client sends before anything else on a file-server socket: it asks which game files it should have, and compares this whole string (the reference uses memcmp over all 21). Answered by whoever holds the file server's address - ArenaNet when the client resolves it normally, this server when the machine's lookups point it here (docs/19-running.md).

response.doc: The 32 bytes to answer with: header 0x02F1, length 0x2000, then six Gw.dat file ids and a zero. These are the ids the reference sends, which are 0x100 below the ones a live client was answered with (docs/03-protocol.md 7); they change when the client's files change, and refreshing them is a capture of the real reply, not an edit made by arithmetic.
